name: collect
description: Ask the person to fill in a form. Show the title and a form for the call's schema. Reply with the filled object, fitting that schema. A field the schema marks secret ("secret": true) is typed masked and never shown back; the reply holds its handle (secret/<uuid>), never the value.

schema.description: JSON schema of the object to fill in

submit.description: What the button sending the form says, e.g. Next
